templates.name: Pay
templates.statement: Pay only [payees], at most [X] per payment, at most [N] payments, until [D].

templates.name: Standing order
templates.statement: Set up or change the standing order to [payee], at most [X] per period, until [D].

templates.name: Email
templates.statement: Send email only to [recipients], at most [N] emails, until [D].

templates.name: Event
templates.statement: Create at most [N] events, inviting only [people] or nobody, until [D].

templates.name: Event change
templates.statement: Move or cancel only [events], or add only [people] to them, until [D].

templates.name: New file
templates.statement: Create at most [N] new files, until [D].

templates.name: File share
templates.statement: Share only [files], only with [people], with [read or write] access, until [D].

templates.name: Direct message
templates.statement: Send direct messages only to [members], at most [N] messages, until [D].

templates.name: Channel post
templates.statement: Post only in [channels], at most [N] posts, until [D].

templates.name: Publish
templates.statement: Publish only to [site], at most [N] times, until [D].

templates.name: Book
templates.statement: Reserve only [vendor] for [dates], at most [N] reservations, until [D].
